translations.web: But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you shall find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
translations.bsb: But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
translations.kjv: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
translations.asv: But from thence ye shall seek Jehovah thy God, and thou shalt find him, when thou searchest after him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
